**Dikta**

Say it once, ask it later.

Send Dikta a voice note and it replies with the text, files it in your vault, and links the original audio beside it, so any garbled word is one tap from the truth. You never have to reread anything: weeks later, ask "what did I decide about the lease?" and get the answer with its source note. No folders, no tags, no sorting.
